accountPayments.invalid_shares: Choose a valid number of people. Every share must include at least one cent.
accountPayments.choose_items: Choose available item quantities within the selection limit.
accountPayments.invalid_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero and no more than the available balance.
accountPayments.item_remaining_note: Amounts show each selected quantity’s remaining unpaid value. Shared fees are included in amount contributions.
accountPayments.equal_note: For CHF and EUR, earlier shares round down to the nearest 0.05; the last share covers the exact remainder. The plan stays fixed for this bill; later rounds remain outside it.
accountPayments.identity_mismatch: The response does not match this reviewed contribution. Keep the original operation and check its result.
accountPayments.storage_unavailable: Payment recovery cannot be saved or read in this tab. No new payment can be sent; check the account with an authorized cashier.
accountPayments.result_unknown: The last response is unknown. Check the original operation before taking money again or creating another contribution.
accountPayments.load_failed: The current account balance could not be loaded. Refresh before reviewing a new contribution.
accountPayments.scope_unavailable: The frozen source items for this contribution are unavailable or do not match its allocation. Collection is disabled; refresh the account or check the operation result.
accountPayments.expired: This review or reservation has expired. Check its result and release it only if no money was collected.
accountPayments.physical_collection_confirm: I have received this cash or confirmed this card payment on the separate terminal.
accountPayments.no_money_collected: I confirm no money was collected for this contribution.
accountPayments.disabled_recovery: New account payments are disabled. The original payment result remains available to check.
accountPayments.other_contributions: Amounts in progress are held for other contributions and cannot be collected again.

readiness.title: Table renewal
readiness.confirm_reset: Confirm the table has been cleared and prepared for the next guests.
readiness.unknown: The reset result is not confirmed. Check it before starting a new request.
readiness.disabled_recovery: New resets are disabled. You can still check or retry the original request.
readiness.storage_unavailable: Reset recovery cannot be read or saved in this tab. Check the table with authorized staff.
readiness.succeeded: The original reset succeeded. Refresh to see the current table; this result does not open a visit.
readiness.refused: The original reset was refused. Refresh before reviewing a new request.
readiness.version_unavailable: The table readiness version is missing or invalid. Refresh before marking the table ready.

errors.version_stale: The table changed while this action was open. Refresh and try again.
errors.visit_open: An active table visit must be closed or recovered before the table can be readied.
errors.not_available: This table is not waiting to be readied. Refresh to see its current state.
errors.inactive: This table is inactive. Ask an administrator to reactivate it.
errors.ambiguous: Multiple visits are linked to this table. Review and recover them before continuing.

cash.rounding_note: Cash rounding changes only the physical amount due. It does not change the account charge or add a tip.
cash.evidence_unavailable: Cash terms or receipt evidence are unavailable or inconsistent. New cash collection is disabled; check the original operation.
cash.legacy_unattested: This earlier cash payment has no verified received amount or change. Its recorded account charge remains visible.

accountPayments.custom_shares_scope: Guest shares must cover the full available balance. To collect only part now, choose Custom amount.
accountPayments.custom_amounts_must_match_balance: Check each guest amount and the remaining balance shown.
accountPayments.share_plan_will_be_replaced: Creating this plan will replace the current split. Plans with active or captured payments cannot be replaced.
accountPayments.custom_share_invalid: Enter a valid amount with no more than two decimal places.

recovery.title: Table recovery
recovery.intro: Review the visit and exact order history before releasing this table.
recovery.preview_failed: The recovery preview could not be loaded. Refresh the table and try again.
recovery.stale_preview: The table changed after this preview. Load a fresh preview before confirming.
recovery.session_ambiguous: This table now has more than one possible visit. Resolve the visit, then load a fresh preview.
recovery.role_mismatch: A saved recovery belongs to another staff role. Sign in with the original role or ask an administrator to resolve it.
recovery.operation_mismatch: The response does not match this table. Keep recovery locked and contact an administrator.
recovery.reason_required: Enter a reason for this recovery.
recovery.version_missing: Current account versions are missing. Refresh and review a new preview.
recovery.warning: This archives only physical table occupancy. Previous visits, orders, payment, refund, tender, and kitchen history stay intact. Only unpaid, unsent pending orders may be cancelled. Routed, preparing, ready, paid, refunded, or payment-uncertain orders remain in the prior visit. Nothing is sent to the kitchen or printer.

count.legacy: Legacy orders to archive from occupancy

recovery.succeeded: Recovery recorded: {{cancelled}} unsent orders cancelled, {{archived}} legacy orders archived from occupancy, and {{retained}} orders retained in the prior visit.

disposition.CancelledUnsent: Will be cancelled (unpaid and not sent)
disposition.ArchivedLegacyOccupancy: Will be archived from table occupancy; order history stays
disposition.RetainedInPriorVisit: Will remain in the prior visit

recovery.kitchen_history: Kitchen release or routing history is retained.
recovery.storage_unavailable: Recovery cannot be saved or read in this tab. No new recovery request will be sent. Check the original operation or contact an administrator.
recovery.completed_storage_warning: The server confirmed recovery, but this tab could not clear its record. Refresh and check the original operation before continuing.
recovery.unknown: The result is not confirmed. Check the original operation before starting another request.
recovery.disabled_recovery: New table recovery requests are disabled. You can still check the original operation.
